subject: [OCAY] winter break trip meeting - members only
text:
Hi all,

If you signed up for the winter break trip (Red Rocks NV and/or Joshua Tree), we have a mandatory planning meeting Thursday 11/19 at 8pm in WLH 208. This one is members only, for people on the trip roster. We'll go over gear, carpools, and permits.

OCAY board
